title: TypeSafe Launches Jev 1.14 With Multimodal and Multilingual Upgrades
summary:
A new set of capabilities for the Jev AI model now allows for the processing of image inputs and expanded context windows. TypeSafe's release of version 1.14 integrates an experimental multimodal system that enables the AI to see, a new box API, and the company's most significant multilingual upgrade to date. The model is now available via OpenRouter with pricing held at $0.042 per million input tokens and free output.

Databricks is partnering with TypeSafe to bring the updated model to its own customers. To protect the stability of enterprise infrastructure, the developer has included a gate that allows tinkerers and early adopters to opt in to a "danger zone" to test the newer, less stable experimental features.
